text: Sales pipeline review: three large accounts (Acme, Globex, Initech) are at risk because their renewal budgets were cut this quarter.
Acme: renewal call is booked for November 12. Maria wants to talk about a discount before signing.
Acme pays in euros and wants invoices sent on the first of the month.
Acme expanded to a second office in Lisbon, which could mean more seats next year.
Globex froze hiring and cut its tools budget by thirty percent, so the renewal is at risk.
Globex champion Dana Whitfield left in September; nobody new owns the relationship yet.
Initech asked for a security questionnaire before they will renew. Due at the end of the month.
Initech support tickets dropped by half after the onboarding fix, which is good news for the renewal.
Hooli renewed early for two years and asked for a case study.
Team offsite planned for November. Sales and support will travel together.
Offsite budget approved: 14,000 for twenty people, flights not included.
Support lead Sam is on leave from the 3rd to the 17th; Lee covers the queue.
Meeting notes, Monday: Priya will book the November offsite venue by Friday. Sam will send the renewal deck to Acme. Everyone reviews the Q4 plan before Thursday.
Meeting notes, Wednesday: Lee agreed to fix the onboarding checklist this week. Maria will call Globex about their budget.
Meeting notes, Friday: Planning moved to next week. Sam owns the security questionnaire for Initech.
Meeting notes, last Tuesday: We decided not to discount Acme before the call. Priya will prepare two options.
Salary table for every employee. Strictly confidential.
Performance review drafts for the support team. Do not share.

Dana Whitfield, former product owner at Globex, now at a competitor; still friendly.
Priya Nair, head of sales at Hooli, prefers calls on Fridays.
